target_customer: Hospitals and imaging centers that outsource radiology reads
problem: There are too few radiologists to read all scans, and operations around reading are slow and outdated.
business_model: Owned radiology practice charging per read, using AI to draft reports that radiologists sign

founders.name: Maryam Jahed
education: University of Waterloo, BASc electrical engineering and BA sociology
previous_startups: Airo Health (co-founder, YC-backed, outcome not researched)

founders.name: Seak Meng Lay
prior_employers: Carbon Health (founding engineer, later VP Software Engineering)

competitors.name: Harrison.ai (Frontier Radiology)
competitors.what: AI company reportedly launching an AI-enabled US teleradiology service

technical_complexity.rationale: AI draft reports plus clinical workflow, PACS and RIS integration, claims and critical finding routing; the practice acquisition adds operational and regulatory work.

defensibility.rationale: Owning a licensed practice with contracts and integrations is harder to copy than software, but Epsilon Health and teleradiology incumbents pursue the same model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents are building AI tooling; no action against Radley recorded.

market_need_then: Company states 1 in 6 scans lacks a radiologist and the gap grows to 1 in 3 within ten years, and claims 2.2M dollars in contracts and 4.6M annualized revenue via an acquisition; all self-reported.

branding.brand_signature: Corgi for Radiology positioning on the YC page

brand_strength.rationale: Plain brand with a borrowed analogy; trade press covered the launch but not the brand.

outcome_analysis: Radley is a Summer 2026 YC company with no outcome yet. Founders scaled Carbon Health operations, which fits the full-stack approach, but the model depends on closing a practice acquisition and competing with funded AI-native practices and incumbents.
notes: Dealroom lists a 125k seed marked AI generated with no investors; unverified, not recorded as a round. Another source gives 4.3M annualized revenue versus 4.6M on YC page. Radiology Business article opened only via search snippet. Founding year not found.
